results.title: East Point Engineering Students Develop AI System to Detect Deepfake Videos
results.description: Bengaluru, September 2026 – As manipulated videos and synthetic media become increasingly difficult to distinguish from authentic content, students from the Department of Computer Science & Engineering at East Point College of Engineering & Technology (EPCET), Bengaluru, have developed a web-based AI-powered deepfake video detection system designed to help identify whether a video has been manipulated. results.title: 5 Zodiac signs who are in love with AI tools
results.description: Today’s digital landscape sees AI tools woven into our everyday routines. Some zodiac signs are particularly adept at leveraging these innovations, reflecting their unique characteristics. For example, Aquarians are always ahead of the curve, diving into new AI technologies before they catch on. Geminis juggle various AI applications, navigating the complexities of subscriptions. Meanwhile, Virgos prioritize using AI to enhance processes and drive efficiency in their work.
